snippet.title: PSX Longplay [234] Extreme Pinball
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: MadMatty

From the makers of Epic Pinball comes Extreme Pinball. I'm not a fan of this game and you may find this a rather long and boring longplay as I am unable to complete any of the tables.  The tables move with quite a low frame rate which can be a bit of a hindrance at times and the wacky ball physics means I can never get the ball to go where I want.

I spend as much time as I can tolerate on each table but i get get quite frustrated when the game is constantly telling me to hit this and hit and not everything is all that well marked so its not always clear how to hit the targets.  Some targets you can hit over and over and not trigger anything. There are so many objectives to meet that I didn't come close to finishing any of the tables..

00:00:00 Medievil Knights
00:21:00 Rock Fantasy
00:38:50 Urban Chaos 
01:05:40 Monkey Mahem -
